raw_translation: Wannan wani simuli ne na arcade na gida mai nauyi, ba wani nau'in layin jiki ba, mai saka kwallaye na gasar ko kuma wasan 'yan wasa da yawa. Zaɓuɓɓukan da ake samu na zagaye ne kuma suna dogara da kulawarka da kuma dama. An yi amfani da dokokin saka kwallaye na USBC; ba'a nuna bambance-bambance da canje-canjen gasar ba. Gamerka na zaune a cikin wannan shafi.
source: This is a lightweight local arcade simulation, not a physical lane model, tournament scorer or multiplayer game. Shot outcomes are approximate and depend on your controls plus chance. The USBC ten-pin scoring rules are used; variants and league adjustments are not represented. Your game stays in this page.
translation: Wannan wani simuli ne na arcade na gida mai nauyi, ba wani nau'in layin jiki ba, mai saka kwallaye na gasar ko kuma wasan 'yan wasa da yawa. Zaɓuɓɓukan da ake samu na zagaye ne kuma suna dogara da kulawarka da kuma dama. An yi amfani da dokokin saka kwallaye na USBC; ba'a nuna bambance-bambance da canje-canjen gasar ba. Gamerka na zaune a cikin wannan shafi.
